lcc_original: 那人便給各樣牲口和空中飛鳥跟野地各樣走獸起了名；只是那人【10】自己卻沒有遇見一個幫助者可以做他的配偶。
notes: LCC uses 各樣 (every kind) twice where UNV uses 一切…都; first 各樣 → UNV 一切 <WAH09001><WAH03605>, second 各樣 (before 走獸) → UNV 都 <WAH09001><WAH03605>

LCC word order for 野地各樣走獸 inverts Hebrew חַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה ('beasts of the field') to 'field every-kind beasts'; <WH07704> placed after 野地, second <WAH09001><WAH03605> after second 各樣, <WH02416> after 走獸

UNV 配偶幫助他<WH05828><WAH09003><WAH05048> (עֵזֶר כְּנֶגְדּוֹ) maps to LCC's 幫助者<WH05828>可以做他的配偶<WAH09003><WAH05048>; LCC rephrases the noun phrase into a relative clause but the two Hebrew roots align cleanly to 幫助者 and 配偶
LCC adds 自己, 卻, 一個 with no Hebrew equivalents; left unannotated
Footnote marker 【10】 preserved in situ after 那人 in the second clause
